claude_subscription.note: The only lane with a real backend wired up in this build (router/backends.py:AnthropicBackend) -- used if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in the environment. Per-tier caps are smaller for the frontier tier, mirroring how real subscription products meter their scarcest/most expensive model more tightly than the cheap one.

openai_subscription.note: Illustrative placeholder model names for whatever fast/balanced/frontier tier this subscription currently exposes. No real backend wired up (see README); always uses MockBackend.
